summary: Amerant Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting its Q1 2026 earnings and a $0.09/share dividend declaration. The dividend was declared by the Board, payable May 29, 2026, to holders of record May 15, 2026. The dividend represents a capital return to shareholders, signaling steady payout policy. No premium, price, or advisory details apply; the filing is furnished under Items 2.02, 7.01, and 8.01. Watch for consistency in payout ratios and potential future increases.
